psst, here's the backstory

why this club exists

Gemini Campus Club began as a group chat full of Aggies trading Gemini prompts and Google AI Studio tricks. We turned it into a standing meetup: a place to learn how Gemini and the rest of Google's AI stack actually work, build something before the semester ends, and get a second pair of eyes before you ship.

No prerequisite besides curiosity. Half the room is CSCE, the other half is business, bio, and a few people who wandered in from a flyer on Ross Street — that mix is usually where the best projects come from.

✦ every week

what we actually do

🛠️

workshops

Hands-on sessions on the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, and agent tooling — taught by members, not slides.

💻

build nights

Bring a laptop and an idea. Leave with a working Gemini-powered prototype and a few people testing it with you.

🎤

speaker series

Engineers building on Google's AI products, back to answer the questions a lecture won't.

how gem was born

Gem hatched the night one of our designers stayed up doodling through a Gemini workshop. A four-point star drifted off the slide deck, landed on a sketch of a bunny, and stuck. The ears took the star's pink and blue, the eyes kept its green — and the maroon linework, plus the ATM on the tummy, are pure Texas A&M.
